title: M. tuberculosis as a Wikipedia taxon
dek: Live sitelink is Wikidata Q130971 (not the stale Q130737 seed). A taxon page is a name, a stain, and a genome pointer — not DST.
story: The English Wikipedia page Mycobacterium tuberculosis currently sitelinks to Wikidata Q130971. A task seed of Q130737 does not resolve to this taxon on live Wikidata (that QID is a fossil synapsid). The lesson is the same as in a mis-keyed accession: check the sitelink, not the anecdote.

The taxon page is a glossary: actinobacterium, acid-fast, slow growth, Robert Koch 1882, H37Rv as a common laboratory reference. Those names already have deeper Simplfy plates (organism envelope, H37Rv genome, acid-fast stain). This card exists so the encyclopedia node can sit in the concept map without pretending to be a cell-wall monograph.
MTBC membership is a different Wikipedia page and a different QID (complex Q5779917). Xpert still answers MTBC, not this taxon. Do not let a species infobox overwrite a cartridge.
deepTitle: Sitelinks, stale QIDs, and what a taxon page will not do
deep: Always prefer the sitelink on the article you actually read. Q-numbers drift in memory; titles plus revision IDs do not.
Laboratory strain H37Rv is a reference genome, not a clinical median. Wikipedia will mention it; the genome plate is where PE/PPE and ESX live.
Growth '4–8 weeks on solid media' is a glossary fact. MGIT time-to-positivity is a different object (liquid, automated, not a Wikipedia doubling-time).
Do not take MIC ranges or critical concentrations from a taxon infobox.

visual.caption: What the taxon page is allowed to name, versus what it must hand off to existing tb-* plates. Size is teaching weight on this glossary card, not citation count.

example.title: The Q130737 seed
example.setup: A knowledge ticket says 'Wikidata Q130737 = M. tuberculosis'. Live SPARQL returns Moschops. Wikipedia's M. tuberculosis sitelink is Q130971.

steps.title: Do not trust a memorised QID
steps.body: Resolve the English sitelink on the page you ingested. That is the identifier the revision stamp belongs to.

steps.title: Write the mismatch down
steps.body: The ledger should record that the seed Q130737 did not match the taxon, so future ingest does not 'correct' Q130971 back to a synapsid.

steps.title: Keep DST off the taxon card
steps.body: Nothing about this identifier fight changes rpoB S450L.

example.takeaway: Sitelink beats folklore. Taxon beats neither WHO nor the catalogue.

check.prompt: On live English Wikipedia, Mycobacterium tuberculosis sitelinks to which Wikidata item?
check.why: Q12204 is the disease, Q130737 is not this taxon, Q798309 is BCG vaccine.

whyWrong.Q130737: Stale seed; live Wikidata uses that QID for Moschops.

check.prompt: A cartridge reports MTB detected. Using only the taxon page, you can conclude:
choices: The isolate is M. tuberculosis sensu stricto Q130971
MTBC nucleic acid is present; this taxon page does not speciate among the complex
PZA is susceptible because Wikipedia lists Mtb as PZA-treatable
check.answer: MTBC nucleic acid is present; this taxon page does not speciate among the complex
check.why: Same rule as the MTBC clinic plate: NAAT ≠ species.

whyWrong.The isolate is M. tuberculosis sensu str: Xpert does not output a QID.
whyWrong.PZA is susceptible because Wikipedia lis: PZA is a WHO/DST question, and M. bovis is intrinsically R.

check.answer: A seed identifier that does not currently sitelink to this taxon
check.why: The plate is teaching identifier hygiene.
